name: Oahu Resource Conservation and Development Council
description: Convenes the Statewide Food Systems Coordination initiative: monthly coordination call, state food systems working group, data landscape convenings, federal funding and land access scans, and collection of other states' food system plans.

name: Hawaii Green Growth
description: Backbone of the Aloha+ Challenge Dashboard, the state's goals tracker, jointly led with the State, the four counties and the Office of Hawaiian Affairs; the UN's only island Local2030 hub; Dashboard Lab supports updates.

name: UH West Oahu Ke O Mau Center
description: Ke O Mau Center for Sustainable Island Food Systems and the Sustainable Community Food Systems program: indicator and metric frameworks aligned to the UN SDGs, a Delphi ranking of food-security indicators, metrics contributed to Aloha+.

name: Transforming Hawaii's Food System Together
description: Priority project of the Ke O Mau Center with fiscal administration by the Hawaii Public Health Institute: community calendar, annual summit, plans catalog, food system mapping, social network analysis, vulnerability and resilience assessments.

name: Hawaii Public Health Institute
description: Fiscal sponsor of Transforming Hawaii's Food System Together; partner in the 2022 to 2023 statewide Food System Needs Assessment.

name: Purple Maia
activities: Research and needs|Baseline data|Track and analyze|Public dashboard|Policy tracking
description: KILO Dashboard of environmental sensor data across partner sites with generated narratives; Hawaii Food+ Policy team tracking food bills since 2021 with a public 2026 bill tracker and a policy incubator.

name: Maui County Department of Agriculture
activities: Research and needs|Baseline data|Track and analyze|Public dashboard|Evaluate
description: The state's only county agriculture department: farmer needs assessments every three to five years, baseline metrics for the Food and Nutrition Security Plan, quarterly food security tracking with Maui Food Bank, a Food System Dashboard and Food Access Map in development, the Maui Nui Food Summit.

name: County of Hawaii Department of Research and Development
description: Funds food and agriculture projects and is developing a county Agrifood System Plan with district data snapshots, a programs directory, an action-plan tracker and an updated value chain dashboard.

name: City and County of Honolulu
description: Office of Climate Change, Sustainability and Resiliency and Office of Economic Revitalization appear as partners in stewards' data work; a 2024 review of local purchasing by county departments.

name: Hawaii Investment Ready
description: 2022 Hawaii Capital Scan on food systems; a food systems investing framework with systems mapping, to be a public resource.

name: Hawaii Good Food Alliance
activities: Research and needs|Baseline data|Track and analyze|Public dashboard|Evaluate
themes: Public Health & Nutrition|Sustainable Economic Development & Local Food Economies
description: Policy and advocacy surveys, alliance-wide assessments, Food is Medicine programs with a monitoring and evaluation model, USDA Regional Food Business Center planning and grants, the Hawaii Good Food Fund, the Farmers Markets and Food Hubs Map, the Farmers Resource Hub.

name: Hawaii Foodbank
activities: Baseline data|Track and analyze|Dissemination|Evaluate|TEFAP eligible recipient agency
description: Feeding America partner and the state's largest food distributor; commissions the State of Food Insecurity in Hawaii survey with the other banks; Neighbor Connector intake; TEFAP eligible recipient agency for Honolulu and, through its Kauai branch, Kauai.

name: Maui Food Bank
activities: Track and analyze|TEFAP eligible recipient agency
description: Maui County's food bank and TEFAP eligible recipient agency; tracks quarterly food security with the county; co-commissions the statewide survey.

name: The Food Basket
activities: Track and analyze|TEFAP eligible recipient agency
description: Hawaii Island's food bank and TEFAP eligible recipient agency; co-commissions the statewide survey; carries GusNIP produce prescription awards.

name: Aloha Harvest
description: Food rescue and redistribution on Oahu; the second-largest distributor in the recorded network.

name: Hawaii Data Collaborative
activities: Research and needs|Baseline data|Track and analyze|Public dashboard|Evaluate
description: Promotes data-guided decision making: Hawaii Population Model, a 211 dashboard with Aloha United Way, a 2024 Data Landscape Report; partners with Hawaii Foodbank on Service Insights intake.

name: Aloha United Way
themes: Household Food Security|Social Equity & Food Justice
description: Stewards the 211 information line and the ALICE reports for Hawaii, both county-resolved and borrowed by other stewards.

name: Department of Business Economic Development and Tourism
themes: Sustainable Economic Development & Local Food Economies
description: State of Hawaii Data Book, the Agriculture Sector Dashboard drawing on the Census of Agriculture, and the Genuine Progress Indicator.

name: Department of Agriculture and Biosecurity
activities: Research and needs|Baseline data|Track and analyze|Public dashboard
themes: Sustainable Economic Development & Local Food Economies|Biosecurity
description: Market Analysis and News Branch compiles agricultural statistics with USDA NASS and publishes dashboards including cattle shipments; owner of the Act 151 strategic plan and the Act 185 food hub pilot report due 2027; farm profitability analysis 2025.

name: Office of Community Services
description: In the Department of Labor and Industrial Relations; administers TEFAP and the Community Services Block Grant, contracting one eligible recipient agency per county and publishing the county split of administrative funds.

name: Department of Education
description: School Food Services Branch; about $77 million a year in food purchases and the 30 percent local target for 2030; annual Local Food as a Percent of Food Costs report.

name: Department of Health
description: Reports local produce purchasing for the Hawaii State Hospital; the Hansen's Disease facility cannot separate local produce in its accounts; WIC state agency.

name: Department of Corrections and Rehabilitation
description: Reports local food purchasing for public prisons, about $10 million a year, and grows produce at its facilities.

name: Department of Hawaiian Home Lands
description: Administers Hawaiian home lands; lessees' water access and rates on Maui and Molokai were raised as a statewide coordination need.

name: Agribusiness Development Corporation
description: Holds and leases state agricultural lands; named by participants for moving fallow land into production and for lease-length data.

name: Department of Land and Natural Resources
description: Holds state lands and water; named by participants for fallow land conversion and lease data.

name: Supersistence
activities: Research and needs|Baseline data|Track and analyze|Public dashboard|Evaluate
description: Agrifood-systems consultancy: author of the Data Stewards landscape assessment and the A.2 plan and A.3 platform to follow; Hawaii Food Atlas tools (SNAP, food prices, port commerce, trade); bill tracking for the Hawaii Farmers Union United; data-systems reviews for food hubs and county purchasing.

name: Hawaii Farmers Union United
description: Farmer membership organization with a public bill-tracking system built by Supersistence.

name: GoFarm Hawaii
description: Beginning-farmer training program; a land access survey with the statewide initiative; a land-back-to-production cohort with Nation of Hawaii and Purple Maia.

name: Malama Kauai
themes: Household Food Security|Sustainable Economic Development & Local Food Economies
description: Kauai community food systems programming and the county-scale data that comes with it.

name: Hawaii Appleseed Center for Law and Economic Justice
description: In-depth analysis of food access and equity policy.

name: UH College of Tropical Agriculture and Human Resilience
description: Research partner to the Hawaii Good Food Alliance; GET Local program.

name: Maui Nui Food Alliance
description: Partner in the 2022 to 2023 statewide Food System Needs Assessment with Hawaii Investment Ready and the Hawaii Public Health Institute.

name: Feeding America
description: National network; Hawaii Foodbank is the state partner; produces Map the Meal Gap and the Service Insights intake platform; the largest outside giver into the Hawaii set in the recorded flows.

name: Nation of Hawaii
description: Runs the land-back-to-production cohort with GoFarm Hawaii and Purple Maia.

name: Hawaiian Earth Recycling
description: Named by participants as a circular-economy producer whose output could be tracked.
